notes: Rules used by proxy_chairman_agent.py. Each rule is deterministic, cites a memory or past Chairman decision, and matches only items that are NOT chairman_only and NOT in a carve-out category. The agent's hard carve-outs are enforced separately in proxy_chairman_agent.py::_fails_carveout() and apply BEFORE any rule match. Rules are tried in order; first match wins.
